title: Deck Icon Exploration
summary: Documented decision and delivery record for the Deck navigation icon. The operator confirmed Round 2 option A, Project facets, on 11 August 2026; AGT-2619 implemented the 24 by 24 currentColor icon at the identified Explorer seam with light and dark proof.

implementationTasks.title: Apply the operator-selected Deck icon

Do not change the active-section icon used by Deck tabs.
